cands.name: Julia Greenfield
cands.bio: Democrat representing North Carolina House District 100 since January 2025. A former nurse who worked in ICU, emergency and trauma care, she later became a stay-at-home mother and helped run her husband's medical practice. She volunteered in school and Jewish community leadership roles.

endorsements.text: Beyond The Ballot (a Sway voting group led by Niayai Lavien) listed her as a recommended candidate in 2026.

cands.gaps: Her exact birthplace isn't stated; only her move from Illinois at age three is. We found no stated positions or actions from her on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buyers, growth and land conservation, immigration or H-1B, policing, or school choice and teacher pay. The Ballotpedia list of bills she sponsored was empty on the page we read. She didn't complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2024 or 2026. We found no documented controversies and no foreign ties.

local.label: Roots 90: She says she moved from Illinois to North Carolina at age three and grew up in Charlotte, and Ballotpedia also says she grew up in Charlotte; her birthplace isn't stated.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Has served in the NC House since January 2025. Before that she worked as a registered nurse (wards, ICU, emergency, trauma), then was a stay-at-home mother who helped run her husband's medical practice from home.
qual.why: She has one term of legislative service, which counts. Her career was in nursing, not law, policy or budget work, so she scores in the middle-to-upper range. Volunteer school and community board roles were not counted.
